# Tender for Water and Sanitation Infrastructure

## 1. Project Description
Upgrade of the urban water supply network and construction of 50 communal latrines in the northern district.

## 2. Requirements
- W1: Technical design for 20km of ductile iron piping.
- W2: Environmental impact assessment (EIA) approval.
- W3: Work plan for construction without interrupting current supply.
- W4: Health and Safety (H&S) plan for trenching operations.

## 3. Submission Details
- Deadline: 2026-12-15
- Submission: via Electronic Portal (https://portal.water.gov)
- Procuring Entity: National Water Authority
